title: Practice: Losing, using up, cutting off

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пропи́ть?
options: an action spreading over the whole object
completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists пропи́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in проигра́ть?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists проигра́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in уничто́жить?
options: making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists уничто́жить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 11 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does из- add in исписа́ть?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists исписа́ть under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).
**исписан** — исписа́ть (perfective): to cover with writing; (pen, pencil) to use up. Wiktionary: ис- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **исписал** — исписа́ть (perfective): to cover with writing; (pen, pencil) to use up. Wiktionary: ис- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to destroy, to annihilate, to obliterate, to wipe out, to blot out, to crush
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пропи́ть — to spend/squander on drink; проигра́ть — to lose; уничто́жить — to destroy, to annihilate, to obliterate, to wipe out, to blot out, to crush; исписа́ть — to cover with writing.
